WITH q AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.valid_from sv, s.valid_to st_to FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
SELECT 'dup receipt+line' chk, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) v FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no,count(*) c, sum(net_amount) net_amount FROM q GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_key outside validity', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE sale_date<sv OR sale_date>st_to
UNION ALL SELECT 'etl loaded after 2026-02', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE etl_loaded_at>=TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01'
UNION ALL SELECT 'null etl', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE etl_loaded_at IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'net<>gross/(1+vat)', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE abs(gross_amount/(1+vat_rate)-net_amount)>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'in staging too', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM stg_sales_line_load)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sale_ts date != sale_date (UTC)', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'web order missing in fact_web_order', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE store_id=900 AND receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web cancelled', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE store_id=900 AND receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='cancelled')
UNION ALL SELECT 'web processing', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE store_id=900 AND receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'store 136/137 lines', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE store_id IN (136,137) AND sale_date<DATE '2025-01-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales on closed/refit days', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM q WHERE store_id=119 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-08' AND DATE '2025-10-12'

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT store_key, store_id, CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE region END AS region_line
  FROM dim_store
  WHERE store_id < 999
), cur_region AS (
  SELECT store_id, CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE region END AS region_line
  FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 999
), movements AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, cr.region_line, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN cur_region cr ON cr.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, cr.region_line, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN cur_region cr ON cr.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
)
SELECT region_line AS region,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26_q3,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25_q3,
  round(100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amt END) - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM movements
GROUP BY region_line
ORDER BY CASE region_line WHEN 'Web shop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, region_line
